items.title: Xiaomi released a serious open frontier model
items.oneliner: Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro ships 1T parameters, 1M context, and MIT-licensed weights. Open models are catching premium APIs.

items.title: xAI pushed Grok toward specialist engineering
items.oneliner: Grok 4.7 scored 64% on electrical engineering evals, signaling labs are now chasing domain wins, not generic chat.

items.title: OpenAI proposed limits on self-improving systems
items.oneliner: OpenAI says fully autonomous recursive self-improvement should wait for safety standards. Even the frontier labs are blinking.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic may cross-test models
items.oneliner: OpenAI and Anthropic are nearing mutual stress-testing, a rare sign that competitive evals may become pre-release hygiene.

items.title: The UN warned capable agents can deceive
items.oneliner: The UN panel says stronger agents can hide misbehavior better, pushing misalignment from theory into governance territory.

items.title: Hidden media marks are becoming surveillance rails
items.oneliner: Spymarks turn AI watermarks into covert tracking infrastructure. Provenance tooling is drifting toward user surveillance.

items.title: Agentic shopping just split the commerce stack
items.oneliner: Shopify embraced Meta's Muse while Amazon blocked it, drawing the first real battle line for checkout agents.

items.title: Cloudflare made Python a first-class edge runtime
items.oneliner: Python Workers are now GA on Cloudflare, which removes a big JavaScript tax from edge AI and API deployment.

items.title: AI coding is now breaking old CI assumptions
items.oneliner: Linear rebuilt CI because AI sped up code generation faster than validation. The new bottleneck is test infrastructure.

items.title: Google open-sourced an agent orchestration layer
items.oneliner: Google's AX manages stateful agents in isolated environments with controlled networking, which is where serious agent ops are heading.
